overview_description.description:
LAIKA is an e-commerce platform for pets that offers a variety of products and services. LAIKA is like a dog with two tails right now. Its platform for pet products and services has been growing in recent months and it’s drawn the necessary investment to keep up its momentum.

LAIKA built a digital platform where users don’t have to go anywhere else to meet said needs. With two main sections; products and services. In the products section, we have more than 4,000 references (among which you can find most of the brands of food, snacks, medicines, accessories, and others). In the services section, we have more than 17 services, all the healthcare, beauty, and entertainment services. All of the above is delivered straight to your home and with the flexibility of choosing the date and time on and at which you wish to receive the order, including same-day deliveries for the main cities and accepting all payment methods, both online and cash on delivery.

about_short_description.short_description: LAIKA is an e-commerce platform for pets that offers a variety of products and services.

product.name: Pet Food and Diets
product.description: Food for dogs and cats, including dry, wet, natural, frozen, and prescription diets.

product.name: Pet Pharmacy (Farmapet)
product.description: Pet health products including dewormers, supplements, vitamins, flea and tick treatments, and other medications.

product.name: Pet Accessories
product.description: Everyday accessories for pets, including collars, harnesses, leashes, bowls, beds, carriers, clothing, and identification tags.

product.name: Pet Care and Hygiene Products
product.description: Hygiene and grooming products such as shampoos, soaps, wipes, diapers, training pads, oral-care items, brushes, and skin-care products.

product.name: Pet Snacks and Treats
product.description: Treats and supplementary foods for dogs and cats, including dental treats, biscuits, chewables, natural bones, creams, and frozen snacks.

product.name: Pet Toys
product.description: Play and enrichment products including plush toys, interactive toys, scratching posts, gyms, balls, launchers, chew toys, and ropes.
